purpose: Keep the Sender's persistent Operator-action-required synchronization and lifecycle conditions that no other unit notifies (ADR 0013): missing Health Connect permission, a removed secure screen lock, storage pressure, an oversized record, a Projection Refusal, an unusable installation key, a refused enrollment, and a completed drain awaiting retirement. Each observation updates them, and the unit raises one health-data-free local notification at each condition's onset, retried until its success is recorded, and clears the condition once observations no longer show it.

inputs.name: run_summary
inputs.description: The latest Polling Run's per-record-type outcomes and reasons, as coordinate-sender-sync@1 checkpoints them, when the observation follows a run.

inputs.name: enrollment_status
inputs.description: manage-sender-enrollment@1's status: no enrollment, or its phase and final sequence.

inputs.name: key_status
inputs.description: The installation cipher's status for the enrollment's key alias: present, missing, unusable, or unavailable.

inputs.name: local_notifier
inputs.description: A seam that raises one health-data-free local notification naming a condition.

inputs.name: sender_storage
inputs.description: The Sender's SQLite database: this unit's own condition state, behind the 3ug seam and storage lane.

inputs.name: clock
inputs.description: The Sender wall clock for each condition's first and last seen times.

outputs.name: operator_conditions
outputs.description: The set of active Operator-action-required conditions, each with its first and last seen times and whether its onset notification succeeded, surviving restarts.

outputs.name: onset_notification
outputs.description: One local notification naming the condition alone at each onset, raised at least once and at most once per onset, never for a condition other units already notify.

observable_effects.name: local-notification
observable_effects.description: Raises one health-data-free local notification at the onset of each condition.

observable_effects.name: sender-storage-write
observable_effects.description: Applies this unit's Sender schema migration and writes only its own condition state.

owns: the list of Operator-action-required conditions this unit keeps and how each is derived from an observation
each condition's onset, persistence, clearing, and the one-notification-per-onset rule
does_not_own: Polling Runs, per-type outcomes, and type blocks, which belong to coordinate-sender-sync
the Sync Checkpoint and its outcome vocabulary, which belong to stage-sync-checkpoint and ingest-protocol
enrollment phases and the final sequence, which belong to manage-sender-enrollment
Delivery Block notifications, which belong to send-outbox-message
restricted and unregistered scheduling notifications, which belong to schedule-background-polling
the notification adapter, its channel, Sender screens, and when observations are made, which the Sender shell enabling task provides
